attributes.name: Azaven
attributes.powers:
Azaven is immune to the Cold, Electricity, Mental, and Poison traits.

Before the encounter, attempt a Constitution or Fortitude 12 check. If you succeed, discard 1 card from your deck; if you fail, discard 1d4+1 cards from your deck.

All damage dealt by Azaven is Cold damage.

"Who will not know my name? For I am forever!"—Azaven the Lich
